A survey of adults, not a census: China's census does not ask religion. Self-declared affiliation from the CFPS 2012 religion module, 2,362 respondents in this province, which the survey drew as an independent, self-representative subsample of 1,600 households -- one of five provinces (Shanghai, Liaoning, Henan, Gansu, Guangdong) for which the survey supports province-level inference. Shares as printed in the paper's Table 2; a group printed at 0.0% is omitted. Affiliation, not practice: the same paper finds about 1% of respondents in any religious organisation.
